notes: English names two distinct sacred locations in the Teeth of Naros quest: Shrine of Air and Shrine of Earth. The Air site is explicitly a holy site at default:19082; the quest journals 8343/8204 establish their separate objectives. Japanese 大気の聖堂/大地の聖堂 and Chinese 空气神龛/大地神龛 corroborate. Reuse the established paired journal forms 대기의 성소(Shrine of Air) and 대지의 성소(Shrine of Earth). Only exact shrine-name spans change, plus the erroneous directional particle 성소으로 to 성소로. The official Korean manual does not name these DLC locations. Do not infer any new relationship or change other entity findings.
